data.statement: Jeremiah announces a new covenant that is not like the covenant made at Sinai.
data.disputed: No — regarding what Jeremiah explicitly states
data.interpretive_divergence: Divergence concerns whether the new covenant supersedes, renews or fulfils the Sinai covenant.

provenance.label: Finding
provenance.detail: A future covenant is announced in explicitly contrastive terms with Sinai.

provenance.label: Claims used
provenance.detail: Sinai covenant obligations; prophetic promise of internalised law.

provenance.label: Supporting evidence
provenance.detail: Jeremiah 31:32 "not like the covenant I made with their fathers".

provenance.label: Interpretations
provenance.detail: Renewal, replacement and fulfilment readings remain separately attributed.

provenance.label: Counterviews
provenance.detail: Readings that treat the passage as restoration language only.
